build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with parameterized scene generation
create_scene_objects: create static bars and dynamic balls in a PHYRE scene using C.add with positioning methods
update_task_relationships: update the task goal by setting body1, body2, and SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING via C.update_task
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to TWO_BALLS using C.set_meta and C.SolutionTier
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid template parameters by raising creator_lib.SkipTemplateParams when geometry constraints fail
